args.subject: Welcome to the Team, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

I hope this email finds you well! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm a colleague at Blue Sparrow Tech. I heard from Alice that you'll be joining our team next week in the marketing department.

I wanted to reach out and personally welcome you to the team. We're all excited to have you on board, and I'm sure you'll do great things here. If you have any questions or need anything as you settle in, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Looking forward to meeting you soon!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
